skills.name: StreamExecutionEnvironment Setup
skills.description: Initialize and obtain a Flink StreamExecutionEnvironment instance using static factory methods to establish the foundation for all Flink streaming programs.
skills.skill_body:
Call one of the static factory methods on StreamExecutionEnvironment to obtain an instance:
- getExecutionEnvironment(): Automatically detects execution context (local or remote)
- createLocalEnvironment(): Creates a local execution environment
- createRemoteEnvironment(String host, int port, String... jarFiles): Creates a remote execution environment

Store the returned instance for use in subsequent data source and transformation operations.

## Objective

Initialize execution environment
## Applicable Signals

- Application startup phase
- No StreamExecutionEnvironment instance currently available
- Preparing to define data sources or transformations

## Contraindications

- StreamExecutionEnvironment already instantiated in current scope
- Using batch-only APIs (use ExecutionEnvironment instead)
- Environment configuration already complete

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Choose factory method based on execution context', 'detail': 'Select getExecutionEnvironment() for automatic detection, createLocalEnvironment() for local development, or createRemoteEnvironment(host, port, jarFiles) for cluster deployment'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Invoke static method on StreamExecutionEnvironment class', 'detail': 'Call the chosen method with appropriate parameters (host, port, jar files for remote environments)'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Store returned instance', 'detail': 'Assign result to a variable for use in subsequent data source and transformation definitions'}

## Constraints

- Must be called before any DataStream source or transformation operations
- Only one StreamExecutionEnvironment instance needed per Flink program
- Static methods are the only valid entry points for obtaining an instance

## Cautions

- Scala API is deprecated; use Java DataStream API instead
- Remote environment requires valid host, port, and jar file paths
- Local environment suitable only for development and testing

## Output Contract

- Valid StreamExecutionEnvironment instance ready for data source configuration and transformation operations. Instance is reusable throughout the program lifecycle.
